nodes.text: We hope you enjoyed both stories!
And we wish you the very best Valentine's Day!

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Hey Spence, you're doing good!

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Why don't you try lifting your feet a little more? Like the way you normally walk.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: You know, when you're being all cool in the hallways?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You think I look cool when I walk?

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Must be the shoes.
Spencer becomes bolder, taking higher steps and traveling on the ice.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Yeah that's it! Now, once you do that, just start taking some gliding steps...
She demonstrates, and a little while later, Spencer is making short strides across the ice.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All right, where's my hockey stick?
He comes over and joins Harper, taking her hand.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're good at teaching.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, want to ditch this party? I want to show you something...

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: If you don't mind taking a picture with me first...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: I think I know where your watch is.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Yeah. The photo I took earlier tells us everything we need to know. Take a look at this.
Harper shows him the picture.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: What's missing from the restaurant now that was here a few hours earlier?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I wish it were that poor dog... Should we let him in?

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Oh, that's Pepperoni Toni's dog, Loni. Don't worry about him. He's been fed, but he always makes that face, hoping for someone's leftovers.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, then I don't know what the difference is.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm really bad at these games. You got me. What is it?

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Your jacket shows up in the earlier picture but not the later one.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh yeah! My jacket!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: I think this might have something to do with your watch's disappearance!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Now that you mention it...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I remember when I wearing it earlier, the sleeves of my coat kept getting caught on the watch's latch.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But I didn't feel that anywhere after the diner.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That means, the watch is probably with my jacket.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: $BOMB? I don't think that's right...

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Oh, sorry... I guess I wasn't looking hard enough.
Spencer examines the photo one more time.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But hey, look here! This photo has my `jacket` in it!
nodes.text_bbcode: But hey, look here! This photo has my [color=#e23b3b][i]jacket[/i][/color] in it!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I totally left it here!

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: What does that have to do with the watch?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I remember when I was wearing it earlier, the sleeves of my jacket kept getting caught on the watch's latch.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That means the watch is probably with my jacket.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm going to talk to the waiters again.
After a few minutes, he comes back.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: One of the waiters reports seeing a customer take it, but no one knows who it is.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: How are we going to find it now?

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: I think I know someone who can help.
Twenty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Aunt Claire! Over here.

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: So... I heard you're missing a watch.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Yes. We were able to trace it all the way back here to where he left his jacket.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: But someone made off with it. We don't know who. It's kind of important.

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: So you said on the phone. I can take a look...
Claire lays a hand down at the table Spencer and Harper sat at.
Then she closes her eyes for a minute, still and silent.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's she doing?

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Shhh!
After a moment, Claire opens her eyes.

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: Whew, that was a little tricky to sort out. There's a lot of traffic in here.

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: But I think I have a read on your watch. We can find it if we follow the trail.

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: Come on...
Claire leads them to various places in Centerscore...

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Did you find it yet?

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: You know, I thought I was on the right track, but it's not... What if we go somewhere else?

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Is it here?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't see anything at all...

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: The spirit of the watch seems to be very confused... Let's try one other place...

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: I don't really see anything here...

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Spencer. I'm usually better at this... Maybe it will show itself later?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't see how. The longer it takes to find it, the more lost it is!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'll never be able to replace the watch! It's gone! Just like my dad!
He punches a locker.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ugh, this is the worst night ever!
Spencer stalks off, leaving Claire and Harper alone in the darkness of the hallway.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Well, that was a disastrous first date.

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: I wish there were more I could have done.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Me too...
Poor Spencer! What if he's lost his dad's watch forever?
Try again and see if helping Harper make some better decisions will make the watch easier for Claire to find!
And also... If you want to see how Claire Hart helped Harper get this date in the first place, check out her new game!

nodes.text: Claire leads them back to the ice skating rink.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I guess it's possible I dropped it here...

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: You didn't drop it. It came here on its own.
She pauses, scanning the area intently as if waiting for a sign.
Spencer leans over and whispers to Harper.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Your aunt is acting `pretty weird...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Your aunt is acting [color=#e23b3b][i]pretty weird...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Yeah, it looks really weird from the outside, huh? But she's doing her job.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What do you think she means by 'it came here on its own'?

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Shh!
After another moment, Claire nods.

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: I see. Your watch has been safe all along.
Claire leads them through a crowd of Centerscore students.

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: Sorry, coming through...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Who is that?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, I think I've read about her before... In the news or something...
At last, they come to a spot where Ben, Jessica, and the cheerleaders are standing.
Claire motions at Ben to come over.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey... What's up?

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: I'm sorry we haven't been introduced. I'm Claire Hart, Harper's aunt.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: Harper is on a date with Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She is! Awesome! Way to go, Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Thanks, man!

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: Ahem... `But` the date's been cut short since Spencer lost something earlier tonight...
nodes.text_bbcode: Ahem... [color=#3b78e2][i]But[/i][/color] the date's been cut short since Spencer lost something earlier tonight...

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: You wouldn't happen to know anything about that, would you?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Would you, Ben? I lost my jacket... It's black. You know the one.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh!
Ben walks to a bench, and from underneath, pulls out the jacket.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry, dude. I found it at the restaurant and figured you'd lost it. I was going to give it to you, but...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I got kind of caught up with Jessica...
Claire takes it from Ben, checking the sleeve and pulling out a gold watch.
Spencer takes the watch from her.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wow, you `are` really good at finding things.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, you [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] really good at finding things.

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: It's kind of a hobby of mine.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This watch means a lot to me.

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: I think I have a sense.

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: I also think you should know, Spencer, that your father is okay.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait, what?
At that moment, Spencer's cell phone rings!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hello?
He listens to the voice at the other end, and his eyes widen.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, hey, can you hold on a second?
Spencer holds his phone away from him and looks at Ben, Claire, and Harper with an urgent look.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ben, I'll see you on Monday, man.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Claire, thanks for finding the watch! Harper's right. You have a gift!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And Harper... I had a really good time tonight. But do you mind waiting around for a few minutes?

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Sure... What's up?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I got a call... It's my dad...
Well, this is a good ending! Good job! Looks like you helped Harper and Spencer have a pretty great date!

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Now come on! Let's go find your watch!
Back at the restaurant...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I just talked with the waiters... No one's seen a watch.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's not here...
Harper takes out her camera.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Hmm... When we were here two hours ago, I took a picture...

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Maybe if I compare what it looked like two hours ago to what it looks like now, I can spot if something's changed!
Harper flips through her photos and finds the one she took...

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Now let's see... What's changed since two hour ago?

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

options.label: Look at the photo from two hours ago.

menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are you sure? I was mostly focused on staying upright...

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: But you did show it to me at some point...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Now that you mention it...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You saw it at the restaurant!

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Then that's where we should probably start.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Remember, you showed it to me when you were talking about your dad...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh yeah...

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: That's where we should probably start...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are you sure? I was mostly focused on staying on the path...

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: But you did show it to me at some point...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Now that you mention it...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You saw it at the restaurant!

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Then that's where we should probably start.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Uh... Maybe I don't remember...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's cool. I should get her to do a reading on me next time.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Maybe she'll do it.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: If we get a next time.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's up to you.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But speaking of next time...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's getting pretty late... I should get you home.
Spencer looks down at his wrist to glance at his watch...
But it's missing!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: My dad's watch...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `It's gone!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]It's gone![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer frantically begins patting himself down and searching the path and grass around him.
Harper drops to her knees to look as well.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I can't lose it! I can't! It's the only thing I have of him!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Do you see it anywhere? What about over there?
After beating a few bushes, he sags against a tree trunk.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It could be anywhere!

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Oh, Spencer, I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What am I going to do? It's not like I can go to the store and get another one!

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Don't give up yet... We can still find it, I know it.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't even remember the last time I had it...

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: I do! You showed it to me at...

nodes.prompt: Where did you see the watch?

menu.title: Tell Spencer!
menu.text: Where did you see the watch?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are you kidding me?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Like she does those weird magic card readings and uses people's palms to tell the future?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I thought those were scams!

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: No, it's not like that at all!

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: She has `actual` powers.
nodes.text_bbcode: She has [color=#3b78e2][i]actual[/i][/color] powers.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Or at least, we think she does.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: She can't tell the future, but she's really good at finding things.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That doesn't mean she's magic though.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: No, she just has an uncanny knack for guessing things about people she's never met.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Like a genius or a Mobile Prize Winner?

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: That's not what the award's called...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You know what I mean.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: My aunt's not a rocket scientist, but she's smart in a different way.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: She's really good at reading people.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: She can tell things about people even when they haven't told her anything about themselves.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: She even knows how to find things when no one else can.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoa... That is pretty smart...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: We like to say that she has powers.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Just try lifting your feet more?
Spencer slides his foot farther out across the ice.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: No! Not like that!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Like how then?
Harper lifts her feet up to demonstrate. When Spencer tries, he slides further on the ice before tripping.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This is impossible...

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Well, you can't just give up.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yes I can...
Spencer heads back in, and Harper follows.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Look, Spence, maybe I should have been nicer, but...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nah, it's my fault. I shouldn't have taken you to do something `I` can't do.
nodes.text_bbcode: Nah, it's my fault. I shouldn't have taken you to do something [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] can't do.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, let's ditch this rink. I have something to show you...

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Oh yeah?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: He's a military guy.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Actually, he's on duty now. He just got shipped overseas.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: My mom and I haven't... Heard from him for a while.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Spence.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I wouldn't be. He's a tough nut. He'll be great.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: I think Spencer's more worried about his dad than he lets on...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, and he left me this watch to remember him by.
Spencer rolls his jacket sleeve back to reveal a gold wrist watch.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: He's had it since forever! It's set to his time, so I know what time it is where he is.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's... It's kind of a good luck thing. I look at it when I get worried.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: It's a really nice watch.
Spencer looks at the watch, then at his cell phone.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, we should probably get to Hector's party.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Oh wait! Picture?
Spencer takes his jacket off while Harper calls a waiter over to take the picture.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This is a little cheesy.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: It'll go faster if you smile.
Spencer and Harper pose and smile at the camera.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Okay, now I'm ready to go!
Downtown at a local ice skating rink, everyone gathers for Hector's party!

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: This is going to be so fun!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's totally iced!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's pretty sweet, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Yeah! How'd you even think of this?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, it could be that I was trying to make an indoor jacuzzi and sprung a leak in my parents' den...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Or it could be that I'm just an awesome party planner!

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: I have a feeling I already know...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Who throws the best parties? This guy!

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Well, I can't wait to skate. This is the best!
Spencer and Harper find some skates and sit on a bench.
Brendan and his friends sit next to them.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Harper, you actually came!

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Yeah, it's a first.
Brendan gestures to his friends.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Have you met my girlfriend, Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Nice to meet you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sure... How do you know Brendan again?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't remember seeing you around school, like ever.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Oh, I don't really have a lot of free time. I work a lot.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Harper works at the library. She's the one who checks out our books. You `must've` met her...
nodes.text_bbcode: Harper works at the library. She's the one who checks out our books. You [color=#e23b3b][i]must've[/i][/color] met her...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Do I look like I've checked out a book?

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Well, if you did, you'd know I was there.
Harper stands up and takes Spencer's hand.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: You ready?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah!
They tread onto the ice. Harper skates to the center and spins!

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: This is great!
She glances at Spencer who's hanging on to the edge of the rink.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoa, it's slippery!

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Have you ever ice skated before?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No. But I figured I can body slam a guy as good as any hockey player. I'm probably great at this!
Spencer pushes off from the edge of the wall and slips! He sprawls on the ice.
Harper helps him up.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Well, you learned the first lesson of ice skating... How to fall.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Okay, maybe I could use a coach.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Okay... Why don't we start slow? Get used to your skates. Try walking slowly in them first.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: And if you feel like you're going to fall, fall `forward.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And if you feel like you're going to fall, fall [color=#3b78e2][i]forward.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer takes a tentative step and slides!

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: No, don't do that!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, it's not that easy...

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Whoops... Looks like I should be more positive...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, sure.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I mean, he's not a bad guy. He's hard as nails.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Like me. I respect that.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But you know, we're not really friends. He's hard to get along with.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: He's really strict.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No way!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: We don't talk or anything like that.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: The only thing we've ever agreed on is sports...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And that's only because we both like watching the wrestling championship!

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Seems like I hit a nerve...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Anyway, he's not really a guy you get along with. He's really strict.

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: Don't you know all this already? Aren't you two friends?

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: We've talked a few times, but we're not really friends. I've seen him around, but you know I tend to stay under the radar.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: It's... Better that way.

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: All right...
Claire closes her eyes, takes a deep breath, and concentrates on what she remembers of Spencer from their meeting earlier that day...

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: You want to know about his personality?

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: He has a kind soul hidden underneath a loud, brazen exterior.

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: But something is troubling him.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: You want to know about his interests?

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: He's definitely more sporty than you.

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: Although that might have been the sports backpack he was carrying when I saw him last...

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Aunt Claire!

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: He enjoys football...

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: Though only up until recently...

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: You want to know about his ex-girlfriends?

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: He had a good time with a very vibrant personality, but it didn't end well.

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: He was very hurt, but he's better now.

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: But something is troubling him. Something unrelated to his exes.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: You'll have to figure that out yourself. That's all we have time for...
At that moment, Harper's doorbell rings!

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: He's here!

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: Have fun! And don't forget to compliment his shoes.
Harper hurries downstairs to answer the door.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, Harper... Sorry I'm late. You live really far away from Centerscore...

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Yeah.. My dad's house isn't exactly in the district.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, so... Nice, uh, dress.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Nice shoes.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Thanks! They're Doty shoes, the brand that never scuffs?

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Yeah, I think my dad has those. Have you, you know, scuffed them?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm trying! It's like a challenge.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Anyway, we're going to have an awesome time... Dinner, then Hector's party, and then I have a surprise for you.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You ready to go?

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Can you do me a favor and take a picture with me?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sure.
Harper takes out her camera and holds it out at arm's length. She snaps a photo as she and Spencer smile.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: I like to document my life.

nodes.speaker: Spencer

nodes.text: It's the weekend before Valentine's Day, and Centerscore sophomore Harper Anderson gets ready for her date with Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: I think I'm all ready! Let's see...

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Cute outfit?

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Check. Great hair?
Harper flicks her just straightened hair to the side.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Check. Camera and purse?
She looks in her purse to find her keys, some cash, lip gloss, a phone, and a slim camera.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Looks like all I have to do is wait for him to arrive!
Harper looks at the clock. It's a few minutes past six.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: I guess he's running a little late... But I just can't wait!

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: I know what I can do in the meantime...
Harper picks up her phone and dials her aunt.

nodes.text: Harper, how are you? I was just expecting your call.

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: How did you know I was going to...? Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Claire
nodes.text: So what can I help you with?

nodes.speaker: Harper
nodes.text: Well, I'm a little nervous... Do you think my date will go well? I haven't really dated anyone...

nodes.text: I'm not psychic, Harper...

nodes.speaker: Harper

nodes.speaker: Amanda

Twenty minutes later...

nodes.text: ...And then Aaron Burr shot Alexander Hamilton in a duel!

nodes.text: Wait... This isn't why I wanted to talk to you at all!

nodes.text: I need a favor... I have to help three of Hector's Love Hotline clients!

nodes.text: I'm a zero with the ladies. Come to think of it, I might even be a negative number!

nodes.text: Then you're perfect!

nodes.text: What? Why?

nodes.text: Sometimes I feel like trying really hard at something makes you learn it the best.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: And you've tried to love harder than anyone I know, Erik!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's true...

nodes.text: Well, okay then! You just got yourself a partner and a hearty companion to boot!

nodes.text: Yay! I love boots!

nodes.text: But... I don't know if I'm any good at this!
Amanda's stomach rumbles...

nodes.text: Tough diet? Or just not hungry?

nodes.text: Neither! I'm really hungry, $ZOE, but I can't eat when I'm stressed!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector wants me to help him with some of the clients from the Love Hotline...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But I'm worried I won't be able to!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww... I wouldn't worry about that! You and Hector have been together forever! And you have a really big heart! You're practically a love expert already!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Thanks, $ZOE... But I don't know the first thing about giving advice!

nodes.text: You know, whenever I'm about to embark on something that fills me with apprehension, I like to team up with someone. Knowing I have someone along for the ride really calms me down.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Would you team up with me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's sweet of you to ask, but I think we're too similar.

nodes.text: You should team up with someone who's different from you, but who's also willing to help.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Like Lyle?

nodes.text: Uh... Too different. I'd stick with humans.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Sure!
As Hannah pulls Zach onto the dance floor, he gives Amanda a thumbs up!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm so happy for Zach!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hi, Denni and Colt! Welcome to the dance!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Here's my jacket, Mark Backbutter. Don't get it dirty with your Spartan hands!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh... I'm Justin.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Just go with it.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Okay...
Justin takes Colt's jacket.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That guy sucks.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: How are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I gotta tell you, Princess, I thought this whole imagine-everyone's-a-Spartan thing was pretty dumb at first. But I admit, I feel a lot better.
Mark walks by...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Hey, girl. Hey, Colt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whoa! Now I'm starting to see everyone `as` Spartans. Who was that really?
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa! Now I'm starting to see everyone [color=#e23b3b][i]as[/i][/color] Spartans. Who was that really?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That was actually Mark.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, right. Wait... Did he call you 'girl'?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I know. I know. He `really` sucks.
nodes.text_bbcode: I know. I know. He [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] sucks.

nodes.text: Denni smiles at Amanda as she and Colt stroll onto the dance floor together...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! Denni and Colt are happy!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Maybe in the back room...
Meanwhile...
At Cowboy Burger, Lee gives orders to the work crew...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Two more orders of `Into The Sunrise Fries` and one `Bar-B-Cupid Burger,` and the rush is done! Nice work, guys!
nodes.text_bbcode: Two more orders of [color=#e23b3b][i]Into The Sunrise Fries[/i][/color] and one [color=#e23b3b][i]Bar-B-Cupid Burger,[/i][/color] and the rush is done! Nice work, guys!

nodes.text: Lee steps around the counter and walks up to Paige, who is sitting in a booth.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Looks like the dinner rush is finally ending...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: I'm really glad you came here...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: And I'm sorry that we couldn't make it to the dance tonight.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're really committed to helping your family...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Maybe too much.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't think so. Family isn't something that comes up much at Monarch Prep.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Unless it's like, 'My family owns three of those.' 'Oh yeah, well, my family owns an island.'
Lee laughs and then holds out his hand.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Come on... I've been wanting to do something all night...
Paige takes it, and he leads her outside.
He hops into his car, rolls down the windows, and puts a slow song on the radio...
Then he gets out and walks over to her...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Paige, may I have this... Really really low-class dance with you?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hee hee. You bet.
He holds her close, and they dance together...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: That was so sweet!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Wait... What was so sweet?
Amanda stands in place for a while, staring into space...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh well! I'm happy!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Urrrg! That's it! Goblins attack!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Come on! We have to get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No! We don't!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: A goblin fires an arrow, hitting Big Gruff in the leg. He takes seven points of damage!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's okay, Palima...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We'll never get a chance to talk if we're always running from goblins.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: But if we stay...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Another arrow hits Big Gruff! Ten more points of damage!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Will you dance with me, Palima?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I... I will.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I can't believe this is happening.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, you'd better believe it, Buster. We're dancing!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Big Gruff and Palima dance in a circle as the goblins surround them.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The goblins draw their bows taut to deliver the killing blows.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I really like you, Palima.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I really like you too, Erik... I... I mean Big Gruff!
Andrew rolls a twenty-sided die.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I can't believe this, but the goblins hold their fire!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: They're actually touched by such a cheesy, sappy occasion.
Back at the dance, Amanda smiles...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Wherever Erik is, I bet Ashley's probably there with him! He's so sweet! She probably likes him!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Now to find Hector!
She heads into the storage room...
